item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows two spherical mirrors used in Arnav’s science class. Shading marks the non-reflecting back of each mirror. Light comes from the object side shown.

Which statement correctly names the mirrors from the way their reflecting surfaces curve?

options.A: Mirror X is concave and Mirror Y is convex
options.B: Mirror X is a plane mirror and Mirror Y is concave
options.C: Both mirrors are convex because both outlines look curved
options.D: Mirror X is convex because its back looks hollow on the shaded side
